messages:
support-liaison: FYI — high-severity customer escalations from AcmeHealth. Started ~07:00 UTC. They see 502s + huge latency on Dedicated pool in ap-northeast-1. Billing spikes reported for some requests.

sam.k: Noted. Any error samples? request ids?

support-liaison: Sent logs in DM. But sample: `req=9f3b2b` -> 502 gateway error, upstream: placement_failed/resource_unavailable. Also repeated 429s for the same customer.

maria_g: Looking at infra metrics: ap-northeast-1 dedicated pools show 100% GPU allocation and a lot of placement_retries. Autoscaler is scaling down then back up aggressively (thrash).

eng-oncall: Timeline: autoscaler downscaled nodes 06:52, then placement queue grew, retry loop 06:54-07:10, API started returning 502/503 for queued placement requests. Failover kicked in to us-west-2 at 07:05.

oliver: Failover = partial. We see auth failures from some requests routed to us-west-2: `auth: token_claim_mismatch` for dedicated customers pinned to ap-northeast-1. Looks like token region binding isn't honored on failover.

eva: Repro steps we used: 1) create heavy alloc workload pinned to ap-northeast-1 Dedicated 2) kill one worker to trigger autoscaler down 3) watch placement queue fill -> placement_failed. Attaching snippet:```json
{"placement_error":"resource_unavailable","attempts":6,"pool":"dedicated-apne1-abc"}```

support-liaison: Customer also reports billing anomaly: after failover some requests billed at hosted rates then disputed. They dropped a billing ticket.

ops-bot: ALERT: GPU pool dedicated-apne1-abc - capacity threshold breached (100%). Autoscaler activity: 9 scale events in 18m.

sam.k: Hypothesis: fragmentation + aggressive downscale/compression of node sizes causing pockets of unusable capacity for pinned workloads. Also token-region binding missing on fallback causing auth errors.

maria_g: Quick mitigations: 1) pause autoscaler for dedicated-apne1-abc (temporary) 2) bump soft cap for reserved pool (+2 nodes) 3) add a config flag to allow cross-region token acceptance during emergency failover (short-term). Thoughts?

eng-oncall: Implementing 1 & 2 now. Running: `curl -XPOST https://infra-api/internal/pools/dedicated-apne1-abc/scale?force=true&delta=2` -> queued.

deploy-bot: IR action: autoscaler pause requested by eng-oncall at 07:18 UTC.

oliver: For auth: short patch to accept tokens from fallback-region if original pool is depleted. Need security sign-off but can gate to emergency-only.

eva: Also seeing noisy-neighbor pattern: single tenant hitting huge batch throughput causing KV cache blowout on some nodes. Recommending per-tenant rate-limits in Dedicated pools + improved admission control.

support-liaison: Customer asked for repro steps so they can validate fixes on their side — sent the snippet + we asked them to retry 5 warmup requests after failover.

sam.k: Long-term: work on smarter bin-packing to avoid fragmentation, and avoid downscales that drop below pinned-tenants' footprint. Also fix token-region binding to gracefully accept fallback with audit.

maria_g: Tracking: create incident follow-up ticket and link to customer billing ticket. Need SRE + Billing + Security sync.

eng-oncall: Last log: placement retries dropping after scale + pause. Monitoring for 30m. Will update thread if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

support-liaison: Customer on conf call at 08:00 UTC. Please have billing rep ready. Thanks everyone.
